messages:
alana: heads-up - i'm starting the llm-routing v3 push at 23:15 UTC. using a conservative FF ramp with enforced cooldowns.

deploy-bot: [info] Rollout initiated for llm-routing v3. Feature flag: route_v3_enabled. Change window 23:15-02:15 UTC.

alana: ramp plan: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% with hold 12m between steps. auto-rollback criteria: (1) error_rate >= 2x baseline in a hold window OR (2) sustained p99 latency +150ms vs baseline for 2 consecutive holds. emergency pin command available.

tom: quick Q - what happens on oscillation between 15% and 40%? do we cap the next step?

alana: in that case deploy-bot will throttle next step to 25% and extend hold to 25m. if oscillation persists after that, we'll pin to previous stable version for that cohort and page oncall.

ops_lead: oncall here. prefer fast mitigation: pin to v2.14.9 at 40% failure across >=3 hosts. require 1 approver for normal rollback before 01:00 UTC, 2 approvers after.

deploy-bot: [note] emergency pin command:
```
/deploybot pin llm-routing v2.14.9 --reason "safety"
```
Manual-approval endpoints set: approvers=[alana, ops_lead].

monitor-bot: [monitoring] Baselines: error_rate=0.55%, p99=220ms, token_cost_delta=0%. Active alerts: error-rate-slo, latency-p99, hallucination-sample.

tom: recommend adding prompt-eval quick-check: sample 200 requests per hold and run lightweight hallucination heuristic; if hallucination_rate > baseline * 3 -> treat as immediate hard-fail (pin).

alana: added hallucination-sample hard-fail to rules. deploy-bot acked.

deploy-bot: [ack] Updated safety rules. Next step (0.5% -> 3%) scheduled +12m.

ops_lead: one operational note: if we see token-cost-delta > +30% during ramp, pause and notify billing team before full rollout.

alana: noted. billing notification hook added to pause flows.

monitor-bot: [update] ramp step complete: 3% active. metrics: error_rate=0.5% (stable), p99=225ms (+5ms), hallucination_sample=0.45% (within range). Next step in ~12m.

alana: i'll be online and watching. will call for manual rollback if any hold trips safety rules. ping @ops_lead if you want me to halt early. :eyes:

ops_lead: standing by. good luck. :rocket:
